skill.name: venue-templates
skill.description: Prepare research documents with bundled LaTeX templates and formatting guidance for selected journals, conferences, posters, and grant agencies. Search, customize, and validate local document files.
skill.summary: Prepare venue-specific research documents with templates, guidance, customization tools, and basic PDF validation.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by LaTeX syntax, Markdown formatting, ordinary publication language, and documented URLs. Two unrestricted file writes are confirmed, and template lookup also permits path traversal to arbitrary readable files.

remediation.issue: Template names can escape the bundled assets directory.
remediation.suggestion: Reject absolute paths and traversal segments, then verify resolved templates remain under the assets directory.

remediation.issue: Customization output can overwrite any writable path.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict outputs to a chosen workspace and refuse existing files unless the user confirms replacement.

remediation.issue: Validation reports can overwrite any writable path.
remediation.suggestion: Validate report destinations and use exclusive creation or explicit overwrite confirmation.

content.value_statement: Researchers must align manuscripts, posters, and proposals with detailed venue rules. This skill provides bundled LaTeX templates, reference guides, customization, and PDF checks.
actual_capabilities: Provides LaTeX assets for Nature, NeurIPS, PLOS ONE, academic posters, NSF proposals, and NIH specific aims.
Summarizes formatting guidance for journals, conferences, research posters, and grant proposals.
Searches bundled template metadata by venue, document type, or keyword.
Customizes templates with titles, authors, affiliations, and contact email.
Extracts PDF page counts and font names through Poppler utilities.
Writes a plain-text report containing selected validation results.
limitations: The guidance was last updated in 2024 and may not match current venue rules.
The bundled asset set is smaller than the venue coverage described in the reference guides.
Margin validation only displays declared requirements and does not inspect actual PDF margins.
PDF checks require Poppler utilities, while document compilation requires separate LaTeX tools.

use_cases.title: Format a Journal Manuscript
use_cases.description: Select a bundled journal template and review page, citation, figure, and anonymization guidance before submission.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Conference Poster
use_cases.description: Use the poster template and design guidance to organize columns, typography, colors, figures, and QR content.

use_cases.title: Structure a Grant Proposal
use_cases.description: Review agency sections and page limits, then start from the NSF or NIH LaTeX asset.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Suitable Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the best bundled template for my [document type] targeting [venue]. Summarize the relevant requirements and identify the exact asset path.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Template Customization
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a customization plan for [template name]. Use my title, authors, affiliations, and email, while preserving required venue formatting.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Compiled Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my PDF for [venue]. Check page count and fonts, state which checks are informational, and list required manual verification.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Submission Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete submission checklist for [venue and year]. Compare bundled guidance with current official rules and flag every unresolved difference.

output_examples.input: Help me prepare an NSF research proposal.
output: Plan the project summary, project description, broader impacts, budget justification, and supporting documents.

output_examples.input: What can the PDF validator check for my Nature manuscript?
output_examples.output: It can extract page count and font names. Margin checking is informational and still requires manual review.

best_practices: Compare bundled guidance with the current official venue instructions before final submission.
Keep an untouched template copy before customization or automated replacement.
Compile early and repeat validation after major content or figure changes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat bundled page limits or dates as automatically current.
Do not rely on the margin result as proof of PDF compliance.
Do not overwrite source templates or important files with generated outputs.

faq.question: Which document types are supported?
faq.answer: The skill covers selected journal papers, a NeurIPS paper, an academic poster, an NSF proposal, and NIH specific aims.

faq.question: Are all listed venue templates bundled?
faq.answer: No. The reference guides discuss more venues than the six LaTeX assets included in this package.

faq.question: Are the requirements current?
faq.answer: Not guaranteed. The skill states a 2024 update date, so users must verify current official instructions.

faq.question: Can the skill compile LaTeX documents?
faq.answer: It provides compilation guidance, but a separate LaTeX installation must run pdflatex, BibTeX, or latexmk.

faq.question: What does PDF validation cover?
faq.answer: It checks page counts and reports font names. Margin output only repeats configured requirements.

faq.question: Which local dependencies are required?
faq.answer: Python 3 runs the helper scripts. Poppler provides pdfinfo and pdffonts for PDF checks.
